question: Ticket 71d1bbfa98b0 says "BaseShim's default receive() drops (disposes of) an origin:test envelope after recording it to test_debris.jsonl, unless the device's shim declares handles_test_mail=True. The shim silently discards the message without delivering it to its device or bouncing it back.", but outline 5.7.3.2.3 reads "It answers what it can itself; when it can't (eg a health question it holds no answer to), it wakes the device and asks." (The outline prescribes that a shim 'answers what it can itself; when it can't…it wakes the device and asks.' Disposal is neither: the ticket adds a third mode where the shim receives a message and discards it without interaction with its device. This contradicts the binary presented in the outline (answer-or-escalate). Note: decision 21 in the ticket supersedes this with a different approach (returning unacted-on traffic), but the ticket as written describes disposal, which conflicts with 5.7.3.2.3.). Which stands, the ticket or the outline?
why_it_blocks: the ticket and the component outline disagree; building it would build one of them wrong
